notes: double arithmetic in the spec's exact order; Java evaluates left to right, rounds every operation (strict IEEE semantics since Java 17) and never contracts a * b + c into an FMA (only an explicit Math.fma would).
Each row is packed into a reused byte[] (8 pixels per byte, MSB first) and written as raw bytes to a 64 KiB BufferedOutputStream over FileDescriptor.out.
Digits are checked explicitly because Integer.parseInt also accepts a leading '+'.
javac --release 25, run with java -cp on the Temurin JRE with default JVM flags: the inner loop is JIT-compiled while it runs.
